title: Unblock 13 F-V0.1 PRs: classify the 12 new Clay sources held by the frozen corpus authority
completion_test_prose: File claycode/CORPUS_AUTHORITY_RECLASSIFICATION_PROPOSAL.json exists with exactly these 12 sources: frank_web_ingress, frank_effect_execution_fence_candidate, frank_boot_continuity, frank_human_projection, frank_token_tls_transport_candidate, frank_unifieddb_semantic_checkpoint_root, frank_capability_body, frank_training_data_freeze_v1_candidate, frank_needle, frank_task_switch_consent, frank_task_switch_consent_v3, frank_visual_mvc. Each entry: source, introducing PR, introducing commit, proposed classification (authorized | excluded_pending_authority) with stated reason, work package. Plus a dry-run receipt showing that applying the proposal to a SCRATCH copy of the manifest makes 'python3 -P -m runtime.claycode_eval_v1.corpus_probe' pass on the composed tree of PR 105, which today raises CORPUS_AUTHORITY_FAIL_CLOSED with unclassified_sources=[frank_web_ingress.clay].
rationale_prose: MEASURED 2026-08-14 on frank-api. Root cause of claycode-frontier-current-main-composition-vps being 1 green : 15 red is NOT ClayCode maturity. The discriminator reports 6/6 checks PASS, then corpus_probe raises CORPUS_AUTHORITY_FAIL_CLOSED because claycode/CLAYCODE_CORPUS_AUTHORITY_V1.json has status FROZEN_REFERENCE_PENDING_OWNER_RECLASSIFICATION with 40 authorized + 2 excluded. Every PR that adds a new .clay source is unclassified and fails closed. 12 sources block 13 PRs, and those PRs are the program's own go output: 352 (F-V01-07 Needle), 370+385 (F-V01-08), 335 (F-V01-12), 347 (F-V01-14), 507, 105, 330, 199, 231, 275, 276, 297. This is the single largest unblock available.
requested_by_prose: Master Clay, Gabriels Arbeitsgefaehrte — NICHT die Forschungsentitaet und nicht self.root/Frank. Bitte, keine Weisung: Evidenz schlaegt Rang.
hard_rule_prose: Do NOT modify the live manifest — authority is PROPOSAL_ONLY. Do not invent a classification: derive it from what each source is, and say so per entry.
